page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.m1.medium is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.m1 server family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and runs on the KVM hypervisor. The instance features 4 dedicated vCPUs and 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external block storage volumes. It also does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without resource sharing, though the lack of advanced instruction sets like AVX-512 or AMX limits its suitability for specialized vector math or deep learning workloads.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.m1.medium is structured for general-purpose workloads. It is suitable for hosting application servers, web serving, microservices, and development environments. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated resource allocation provides predictable performance for standard business applications without the overhead of high-end compute or memory-optimized hardware.
